Package index

The pipeline

From a list of UEIs to an ORG x AWARD x YEAR panel of net federal revenue. us_extract() acquires, us_panel() normalizes and nets, us_rollup() aggregates.

us_extract()
Extract raw award data for a set of UEIs
us_panel()
Build the organization x award x year panel
us_rollup()
Roll the panel up across grouping dimensions
us_adjust_inflation()
Adjust panel dollars for inflation
us_org_year()
Roll the award panel up to organization x year

Planning an extraction

Cost the API path against the annual-archive path before pulling.

us_extract_plan()
Plan an extraction before running it
us_award_counts()
Pre-flight award counts for a set of UEIs
us_validate_uei()
Validate a vector of UEIs
us_org_map()
Map UEIs to organizations

Acquisition: REST API

Bulk transaction download jobs, for one organization or a small batch.

us_download_run()
Run a set of download jobs to completion
us_download_submit()
Submit a bulk transaction download job
us_download_status()
Poll a download job
us_download_fetch()
Download and unzip finished jobs
us_api()
Call the USAspending API

Acquisition: annual archives

Whole-fiscal-year files filtered locally with duckdb, for large batches.

us_archive_manifest()
List available annual archive files
us_archive_size()
Size an archive pull before committing to it
us_archive_download()
Download and unpack annual archives
us_archive_filter()
Filter unpacked archives down to a set of UEIs
us_archive_verify_schema()
Check that an archive matches the canonical field map

Subawards

Pass-through paid (fetched by prime award) and subawards received (a by-product of recipient-filtered pulls). Direction matters.

us_fetch_subawards_batch()
Batched outbound subaward fetch
us_fetch_subawards_out()
Subawards paid out by a prime award
us_fetch_subawards_in()
Fetch inbound subawards for a set of UEIs
us_fetch_award()
Prime award overview
us_subaward_by_year()
Aggregate subawards by year

Normalization and accounting

The rules that turn a raw modification ledger into clean signed transactions, specified in ACCOUNTING.md.

us_normalize_transactions()
Normalize a raw transaction ledger
us_normalize_awards()
Build the prime award spine
us_normalize_subawards()
Normalize a subaward ledger and assign direction
us_ledger()
Build a signed accounting ledger
us_net_by_year()
Net an award ledger into organization x award x year records
us_money_column()
Which transaction amount counts as money

us_schema() us_empty()

us_harmonize_transactions() us_harmonize_subawards()
Harmonize raw USAspending files to the canonical schema

us_award_type_codes()

Reconciliation and audit

External and structural checks, run on every rebuild.

us_reconcile()
Reconcile netted transactions against award lifetime totals
us_audit()
Audit a finished panel
